snap-pi-hole.description: Source of the pihole-by-rajannpatel snap. Use for snapcraft.yaml (apps, daemons, plugs, layouts, install-mode), the configure hook (which snap set keys are accepted), and bin/launcher-ftl, bin/launcher-pihole, bin/snap-check, bin/pihole-config.sh.

ops.description: The ops framework itself. Use examples/machine-tinyproxy for the canonical machine-charm reference layout, and testing/ for ops.testing internals.

charmlibs.description: Source of charmlibs-snap, charmlibs-systemd, charmlibs-apt. Use to check real API signatures instead of guessing.

fp-edge.description: Workshop material on functional-style charms. Read code/src/charms_examples/case_study/step2_functional for the fetch/compute/apply split and the outcome ADT. Educational only, not production code — see the charm-functional-style skill for caveats.

flaplint.description: Static analyser for relation-databag ordering churn. Read docs/taint-model.md and docs/sinks-and-findings.md to interpret a finding.
